project_description: This project aims to predict the concentration of Ammonium Lactate-soluble Phosphate (AL-P2O5) in soil samples based on other measured soil properties. The goal is to develop a regression model that can estimate AL-P2O5 values from various chemical and physical soil indicators.

features.mehlich3_p: Phosphorus concentration (ppm) measured using the Mehlich-3 extraction method, indicating plant-available phosphorus.
features.organic_matter: Percentage of organic matter (OM, %) in the soil, which affects nutrient retention and soil fertility.
features.usda_soil_type: USDA soil classification code (USDA5), representing the soil texture or type category.
features.lime_content: Percentage of lime (CaCO3, %) in the soil, indicating soil alkalinity and buffering capacity.
features.ph_kcl: Soil pH measured in a potassium chloride (KCl) solution, reflecting soil acidity or alkalinity.
